title: Skip blank lines in the JSONL processor instead of raising

files.patch:
@@ -10,8 +10,9 @@ class JSONL < Base
       # @param [File] data
       # @return [Array of Hash]
       def parse(data)
-        data.read.lines.map do |line|
-          ::JSON.parse(line)
+        data.read.each_line.filter_map do |line|
+          line.strip!
+          ::JSON.parse(line) unless line.empty?
         end
       end
     end

@@ -17,5 +17,12 @@
     it "parses the file and returns data" do
       expect(described_class.new.parse(file)).to eq(data)
     end
+
+    it "skips blank lines instead of raising" do
+      require "stringio"
+      io = StringIO.new(%({"a": 1}\n\n  \n{"a": 2}\n))
+
+      expect(described_class.new.parse(io)).to eq([{"a" => 1}, {"a" => 2}])
+    end
   end
 end
